Byte-level OPEN -> RE during migration (bootstrap: HVMEC editor D64s + Fenek's 2006 reimplementation). Cleared to start. See pipelines/gmc/docs/README.md.

sidduzzit.notes: research-player sweep complete (2026-06-13, gather-only/sonnet): fully open source (TASS player SRC_SDI21-N50/SPD50.asm) + 65KB official docs + Psylicium manual, kept in docs/src/. Player API ($1000 init/$1003 play/$1006 fade/$1009 speedplay), 4 voices (3+conductor), 10-col-major instruments, waveform-bytecode + pulse/filter/vibrato program tables, FX+note sequencer all captured. KEY: ~25 rem_* assembly flags strip unused effects -> music-data/table bases NOT fixed-offset, must be dataflow-located per tune (FC/DMC-style). V1.x!=V2.x (NTSC vs PAL, incompatible); HVSC overwhelmingly V2 at $1000. Siblings SIDSys/Comptech-X/Echo are separate engines. OPENs deferred to migration (write order, rem_* fingerprint, speed-bit survey). Cleared to start. See pipelines/sidduzzit/docs/README.md.

xample.notes: research-player sweep complete (2026-06-13, gather-only/sonnet). X-Ample/Compotech (Markus Schneider et al., X-Ample Architectures, Germany 1988-97; 380 HVSC tunes). Closed, BUT an annotated V3.2 TurboAss player source ships on the Compotech V2.1 D64 (CSDb #122614) -> player architecture + effect set captured (VBI, 3-voice bitmask, +7 stride; vibrato/glide/arp/drum/pulse/filter/echo/tremolo/fade/velocity). Lineage: Schneider driver -> Parsec V5.1 -> Compotech V1/V2.1; XTracker (V3.1/V4.1x/V4.2x) by SoNiC (separate author; V3.1 player byte-identical to V2.1) -> likely ONE data format + per-variant write-quirk flags. X-Ample_Digi = CIA2-NMI sample (Mode-2, out of scope; 0 confirmed in HVSC). Reflextracker is a DIFFERENT engine (not X-Ample). Census: layouts A(192)+B(118) ~82%, likely same player w/ flipped header. Song-data byte layout OPEN -> RE during migration. Cleared to start. See pipelines/xample/docs/README.md.
